title: The Override Gap: A Magnitude Account of Knowledge Conflict Failure in Hypernetwork-Based Instant LLM Adaptation
authors: Shuaizhi Cheng; Xiang Shi; Zhiwei Zhang; Mingwei Li
why_relevant: Studies knowledge conflict between parametric pretrained knowledge and new document-derived knowledge injected via hypernetwork adapters, proposes conflict-aware mechanisms, and releases a benchmark grading conflicts by prior strength. Comparisons to RAG on conflict tiers are directly relevant.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on parameter-space internalization rather than retrieval-augmented generation per se; relevance is via the conflict framing and benchmark.
